metadata.title: Complex hyperbolic surfaces whose closed geodesics are all simple
metadata.abstract: We show that all closed geodesics in any arithmetic complex hyperbolic surface of second type are simple. These include the fake projective planes studied by Mumford, Klingler, Prasad-Yeung, and Cartwright-Steger.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 第二类算术复双曲曲面的简单闭测地线
analysis.workSummary: 证明第二类算术复双曲曲面的所有闭测地线均简单，覆盖假射影平面等例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 将闭测地线的无自交性与特定算术类型联系。
analysis.limitations: 算术第二类条件关键，不能推广至所有复双曲曲面。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 Pro 仅在稿件制作末期纠正语法、拼写和排版，数学及其他内容由作者提出。
